Name: Thebez
Description: Thebez was the town to whose tower the people fled when Abimelech attacked it, and from whose tower a woman dropped a millstone on Abimelech's head, mortally wounding him.
BiblicalSignificance: Thebez is where Abimelech's violence ended: killed by a woman's millstone, as David's later taunt at Bathsheba's husband recalled.
